h: Moshe's Hoshana: "Adon HaMoshia" and the Water Libation

p: The Hoshana for the Ushpiza of Moshe
the first day, the Ushpiza of Avraham:
for he fulfilled the entire Torah
יוֹם שֵׁנִי אֶבֶן שְׁתִיָּה, בֵּית הַבְּחִירָה,
which is the Ushpiza of Yitzchak,
is called "the first of the converts" (Chagigah 3a).
for he became a native in Yisrael,
and he too was called by the name Yisrael
מִכָּל מָקוֹם עַד שֶׁלֹּא נוֹלַד יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ
nevertheless, until Yaakov Avinu was born
he is called "the first of the converts";
which is not so of Yitzchak, Yaakov's father,
"And Yitzchak went out to meditate in the field" —
at the site of the Beis HaMikdash.
they recognized the place of the altar
And on the third day we say
corresponding to Yaakov Avinu, alav hashalom,
who built a house in Yisrael,
who brought down holiness to Yisrael.
brought down the words of Torah to Yisrael,
וְלֵית לָךְ מִלָּה לְתַבְּרָא יֵצֶר הָרָע
and "there is nothing that breaks the yetzer hara
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר חֵלֶק א רב, א).
besides You there is none to save,"
along the lines of what Chazal said
from the accusation of the yetzer hara.
all the days of the festival
"If I am a master, where is My fear?"
And as we said on Shabbos Teshuvah,
that even through the lower teshuvah, out of fear,
which is from the last attribute —
and "the Shabbos of the eve of Shabbos:
she is fear, and fear rests in her"
one also merits the higher teshuvah
up to the Throne of Glory (Yoma 86a),
which includes all the nine attributes
and "the upper tip alludes to Ayin"
And Sukkos is the time of the war of Gog and Magog
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַב הַטּוּר אוֹרַח חַיִּים סִימָן תצ
in the name of Rav Hai Gaon).
"In Tishrei they will be redeemed" (Rosh Hashanah 11a)
in the passage beginning "Come and see":
are a halachah l'Moshe miSinai, etc.
The place that is called Mount Sinai,
"And then they will perform the water libation,
'For the earth shall be full of knowledge
as the waters cover the sea' (Yeshayah 11:9)."
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
according to what is said in the holy Zohar
(דִּבּוּר הַמַּתְחִיל וְתָא חֲזֵי בְּהַאי חַגָּא וְכוּלֵּי):
(in the passage beginning "And come and see, on this festival," etc.):
that flow forth from the upper, hidden Yerushalayim."
For Yerushalayim is Malchus, the mouth,
the Torah she'b'al peh, the lower wisdom;
that was hidden away for the tzaddikim for the time to come,
which is the upper tip of the yud
of Rabbi Akiva and his colleagues —
כָּל יְקָר רָאֲתָה עֵינוֹ (אִיּוֹב כח, י),
"Every precious thing his eye has seen" (Iyov 28:10):
"this is Rabbi Akiva and his colleagues"
and according to their own intellect and understanding.
וְעַל זֶה אָמְרוּ (בָּבָא בַּתְרָא יב, ב):
And about this they said (Bava Basra 12b):
But when he arrives at the true conclusion
and a halachah l'Moshe miSinai is stated in accordance with him,
For this only Moshe Rabbeinu merited,
And these are "a halachah without a reason"
And although there is a reason,
it is only like Rabbi Shimon,
who expounds the reason of the verse
but in truth they are decrees.
And this only Moshe Rabbeinu merited,
who was humbler than any man.
"And wisdom — from where shall it be found?"
meaning that his wisdom came from Ayin,
which is the hidden holy Atika,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב סד, ב),
And this is the crown of the yud,
which is the light that was hidden away.
that flow forth from the upper, hidden Yerushalayim":
the hidden light, the tip of the yud;
and its tip is the light that was hidden away,
And this was merited only "from Sinai,"
בַּסְּנֶה, לָאו מִשּׁוּם דִּגְבִיהַת מִכָּל אִילָנֵי
of the bush: "Not because you are taller than all trees
אַשְׁרֵי קוּדְשָׁא בְּרִיךְ הוּא שְׁכִינְתֵּיהּ עֲלָךְ,
did the Holy One, blessed be He, rest His Shechinah upon you,
אֶלָּא מִשּׁוּם דְּמַיְיכַת מִכָּל אִילָנֵי וְכוּלֵּי
but because you are lower than all trees," etc.
that the Holy One, blessed be He, is destined to do,
when the Holy One, blessed be He, will remove
when pure living waters will descend
And this is what is said:
And it concludes: "Then it is written (Yeshayah 12:3):
'And you shall draw water with joy
which pour forth into this salvation," etc.
And this is why we say "Adon HaMoshia," etc.
And likewise, his sefirah is Netzach.
And it is stated in the Gemara (Berachos 58a):
this is the downfall of the wicked nation,"
for in it will come the defeat of Gog and Magog.
And in the Midrash Rabbah (Vayikra Rabbah 30:2),
"Pleasantness is at Your right hand forever":
"Whoever takes the palm branches in his hand,
we know that they are the victors," etc.

paragraphs.text: Yoma 28b — "Rav said: Avraham Avinu fulfilled the entire Torah, as it says, 'Because Avraham listened to My voice and kept My charge, My commandments, My statutes and My Torahs' (Bereishis 26:5). Rav Shimi bar Chiya said to Rav: Perhaps only the seven mitzvos? — There was milah too! — Perhaps seven and milah? — If so, why 'My commandments and My Torahs'?"

paragraphs.text: Berachos 5b — "Rabbi Yochanan said: Granted Torah and kindness, as it is written, 'Through kindness and truth iniquity is atoned' (Mishlei 16:6): 'kindness' is acts of kindness… and 'truth' is Torah, as it is said, 'Buy truth and do not sell it' (Mishlei 23:23)."

paragraphs.text: Chagigah 3a — "Rava expounded: What is meant by 'How beautiful are your feet in sandals, O daughter of the noble (bas nadiv)' (Shir HaShirim 7:2)? How beautiful are the feet of Israel when they go up for the festival! 'Daughter of the noble' — the daughter of Avraham Avinu, who is called noble, as it says, 'The nobles of the nations are gathered, the people of the God of Avraham' (Tehillim 47:10) — the God of Avraham and not the God of Yitzchak and Yaakov? Rather, the God of Avraham, who was the first of the converts."

paragraphs.text: Parallel: Pri Tzaddik, Vayeira 1 — “Avraham our father is called the first of the converts (Chagigah 3a), for at first our fathers were idol worshippers… and he merited the name ‘Eisan HaEzrachi,’ who is Avraham our father, as they said, that he merited to be called a native in Israel, meaning one who is from the root and holy stock of Israel, as in the Zohar (Emor); and this is a deep matter, hidden and concealed in this world: how is it possible to change the root?” Connection: Both discuss how Avraham, “the first of the converts,” became “Eisan HaEzrachi,” a native of Israel.

paragraphs.text: Zohar I, Mikeitz 202a — “We learned: A person should always rouse the good inclination against the evil inclination and strive against it. If it departs from him, well; if not, he should occupy himself with Torah, for there is nothing that breaks the evil inclination except Torah. If it departs, good; if not, let him remind it of the day of death in order to break it.” The Zohar gives a sequence of active resistance, Torah and remembrance of death. Rav Tzadok emphasizes the Oral Torah's lived study as the means of transforming the inward enemy.

paragraphs.text: Zohar I 5b, Introduction — “Another Shabbos remained unmentioned and was ashamed. She said before Him: ‘Master of the world, from the day You made me I have been called Shabbos, yet there is no day without night.’ He said to her: ‘My daughter, you are Shabbos and I call you Shabbos, but I now crown you with a higher crown.’ He issued a proclamation: ‘My Sanctuary you shall fear.’ This is the Shabbos of Shabbos eve, which is fear, and fear rests within her.” The passage’s 5b marker precedes this teaching, and 6a follows it. The sanctity of Shabbos night is expressly joined to reverence, explaining its relation to the guarding aspect of Malchus.

paragraphs.text: Raaya Mehemna, Zohar III 258a (Pinchas) — "The tefillin of the Master of the world are Keser. And what is the Keser of the Master of the world? Havayah: yud is Chochmah, hei is Binah, vav is Tiferes, comprising six sefiros, and hei is Malchus." The four letters span the nine middos, and Keser above them is alluded to only in the upper tip of the yud.

paragraphs.text: Zohar III 65b (Acharei Mos) — "Come and see: the yud at first is the totality of all, hidden on every side, its paths not yet opened, the totality of male and female. The tip (kotz) of the upper yud alludes to Ayin [Keser]. Afterward the yud brings forth that river which flows out of it."

paragraphs.text: Rosh Hashanah 11a — "On Rosh Hashanah the servitude of our fathers in Egypt ceased; in Nissan they were redeemed, and in Tishrei they are destined to be redeemed" — the view of Rabbi Eliezer, who derives that the world was created in Tishrei from "Let the earth sprout grass… fruit tree" (Bereishis 1:11).

paragraphs.text: Zohar I, Addenda — "Come and see: the ten saplings, the willow and the water libation are a halachah given to Moshe at Sinai. Other matters of the Torah are called 'Torah,' and here 'halachah' — why? Because this place called Mount Sinai, the Oral Torah, taught it to Moshe, to tie the knots of faith."

paragraphs.text: Pirkei Avot 1:1 — “Moses received Torah from Sinai and transmitted it to Joshua; Joshua to the elders; the elders to the prophets; and the prophets transmitted it to the Men of the Great Assembly. They said three things: Be deliberate in judgment, raise up many students, and make a fence for Torah.” The transmission culminates in the assembly whose program Rav Tzadok invokes: the expansion of students and the protection of Torah through a fence.

paragraphs.text: Zohar II, Beshalach 64b — “Rabbi Abba said: What is meant by ‘Is the Lord in our midst, or nothing?’ Were Israel fools who did not know this matter? Had they not seen the Divine Presence before them and the clouds of glory surrounding them? ... Rather, Rabbi Shimon said this: They wished to know the difference between the Ancient One, concealed beyond all concealment, who is called Nothing, and Zeir Anpin, who is called the Lord. ... Why, then, were they punished? Because they made a separation and put it to a test. They said: If it is this One, we will ask in one manner; if it is this One, we will ask in another manner. Therefore, immediately, ‘Amalek came.’” The Zohar interprets Israel's question at Massah as a question about the degree from which Divine governance was being revealed. It explicitly names the concealed Atika as Ayin.
